blocks.text: Condo buildings in Bayridge
Streets, schools and getting around Bayridge

items.t: Bayridge, as researched, is the residential slope around West Bay Elementary and the Westmount / West Bay shore in the District of West Vancouver, west of Ambleside and Dundarave, along the Marine Drive waterfront west of 31st Street toward Caulfeild. No official District neighbourhood or planning-area name "Bayridge" was confirmed in the District sources read, and no street-by-street boundary for the name was confirmed — boundaries: UNVERIFIED. Confirmed anchors inside the area's usual extent are West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, Benbow Park, 3151 Westmount Place, and West Bay Park, 3482 Marine Drive.
Where the condo stock concentrates: it does not.

Market figures: none exist for this area in Jared's reports. West Vancouver is outside the SnapStats coverage in the FVR + GVR September 2026 reports (coverage is Surrey, S Surrey White Rock, Cloverdale, Langley, North Delta, Abbotsford, Mission, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, New Westminster, Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge only) — sub-area inventory, solds, sales ratio and community medians for Bayridge / West Vancouver: UNVERIFIED, with no substitute source used.

Transit anchors: TransLink route 250 (Vancouver / Dundarave / Horseshoe Bay) runs via Marine Drive through the area, linking east through Dundarave, Ambleside and Park Royal over the Lions Gate Bridge to downtown Vancouver and west toward Horseshoe Bay. There is no SkyTrain or rapid-transit station in or near the area — Park Royal is the exchange point named in West Vancouver timetable routes.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Bayridge

items.t: District zoning and plan (not Burnaby's): the governing bylaws are West Vancouver Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010 — Section 200 RS single-family zones state minimum site areas of 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3 and RS10, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5 — and the District of West Vancouver Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018; Council adopted OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 5406, 2025, bringing the OCP into alignment with the Interim Housing Needs Report. A local area plan naming Bayridge is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).

Foreshore and hazard permits — the live check on this shore: the District requires a Foreshore Development Permit for work within the Foreshore Development Permit Area (waterfront property or other properties at risk of coastal flooding), an Environmental Development Permit for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank, and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area, described as within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface.

West Vancouver property taxes: District of West Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty applied to unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; approximately 50% of the tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities. West Vancouver water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District.

Additional school tax at these price points: the Province's additional school tax can apply — 0.2% on the residential portion of assessed value between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% on the portion above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.

blocks.text: Good to know about Bayridge

items.t: The name itself is the trap. Sell and search on the verifiable anchors instead: West Bay Elementary at 3175 Thompson Place, Benbow Park, West Bay Park at 3482 Marine Drive, and the Marine Drive shore.

This area was filed with Burnaby research, and it is not Burnaby. 4662, 2010, not Burnaby's 2026 bylaw), different tax due date (July 2, 2026, not Burnaby's July 3), and no SnapStats coverage. Copy carried over from a Burnaby page would be wrong here on all four points.
The District lists a Westmount active-transportation project.

The OCP was amended for housing needs in 2025. Council adopted OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 5406, 2025, bringing the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018, into alignment with the Interim Housing Needs Report — the policy frame any future multi-unit proposal on this slope would be read against.

The elementary school is a programme draw, stated precisely. West Bay Elementary offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme, and West Bay remains the catchment elementary for the sample address at 3175 Thompson Place — the programme is a school programme, not a separate catchment, and other addresses still need their own locator check.

Half the tax bill is not the District's. Approximately 50% of the West Vancouver tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities — and the additional school tax rates rise on January 1, 2027 (to 0.3% between $3 million and $4 million and 0.6% above $4 million), a dated carrying-cost change for higher-value homes on this slope.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Bayridge
Secondary suites and ground-oriented multi-unit houses are not townhouse complexes

West Vancouver's RS zones permit a secondary suite and a detached secondary suite (suites must be registered with the District), and the bylaw's ground-oriented dwelling rules state 4 dwellings maximum per lot, and 6 maximum if the site is wholly or partly within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop. A multi-unit house on a Bayridge lot under those rules is a freehold house with suites, not a strata townhouse complex, unless a strata plan is actually registered for the specific lot — UNCONFIRMED for any Bayridge lot in the sources checked.
District townhouse stock exists — in other sub-areas, counted in their own files, never here

The T2 assembly records West Vancouver's verified townhouse pockets as Whitby Estates, Caulfeild, and small components inside two projects in Dundarave and the British Properties/Uplands, with Ambleside, Altamont, Chartwell outside Whitby, Chelsea Park and Bayridge verifying zero. A buyer told a townhouse is "in Bayridge" is being shown another sub-area's stock.
Rental look-alike, District-wide note

Villa Maris (Dundarave) is purpose-built RENTAL, never stock — it is outside Bayridge in any case and is named here only because District-wide rental product is routinely misread as strata stock in West Vancouver searches.
Park Royal split, District-wide note
Park Royal straddles the District of West Vancouver and Capilano IR No. (Standing position for this batch; see the T2 assembly on disk.)
Streets, schools and getting around Bayridge

items.t: Stated openly: "Bayridge" is a site/area name only. No official District of West Vancouver neighbourhood or planning-area name "Bayridge" was confirmed in the District sources read (the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No.

Boundaries: UNVERIFIED — no District neighbourhood or community plan map text naming Bayridge boundaries was confirmed from an official source. The confirmed anchors inside the area name's usual extent are West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, Benbow Park, 3151 Westmount Place, and West Bay Park, 3482 Marine Drive. Nearby areas: Dundarave (east, along Marine Drive), West Bay / Cypress Park shore (west and south-west, toward Caulfeild), Altamont and the British Properties (north, uphill), and Ambleside (far east, the District town centre). Note the same-name care needed in marketing: "West Bay" is both the elementary school name and the shore area name here — neither makes "Bayridge" an official District name.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: nowhere —. The confirmed stock is single-family dwellings in the RS zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662 on the slope above Marine Drive and on the waterfront streets, with secondary suites and detached secondary suites permitted in those zones.
All market figures for this area: UNVERIFIED.

Schools: SD45 catchments are address-based, and SD45 has no middle-school tier — elementary is Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary is Grade 8 to Grade 12. West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, Kindergarten to Grade 7, offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme. For the sample address 3175 Thompson Place, the SD45 School Locator result (Baragar, run 2026-10-21, recorded in the master research) is West Bay Elementary (Primary K–3 and Elementary 4–7) and Rockridge Secondary (8–12); catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator.

Parks, recreation and services: Benbow Park is at 3151 Westmount Place and West Bay Park is at 3482 Marine Drive, both inside the area. The West Vancouver Community Centre and Aquatic Centre, 2121 Marine Drive in Ambleside, is the District's main indoor recreation facility serving Bayridge, and West Vancouver Memorial Library, 1950 Marine Drive in Ambleside, is the District's library. Lions Gate Hospital, 231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver, is the hospital serving the North Shore. No shopping centre or grocery store inside Bayridge is confirmed on a District source — UNVERIFIED; District development permit guidance names Dundarave Village Neighbourhood Centre (east) and Park Royal Shopping Centre (far east) as the District's Form and Character commercial areas. Transit: TransLink route 250 (Vancouver / Dundarave / Horseshoe Bay) runs via Marine Drive through the area, over the Lions Gate Bridge to downtown Vancouver. Marine Drive is the through road along the shore.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Bayridge

items.t: There is no strata townhouse stock in Bayridge to apply strata diligence to today — the strata rules below govern any strata product a buyer is told is "in Bayridge" (it will in fact sit in another sub-area) and any future strata registration on a Bayridge lot: Form B diligence: Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Fee-simple houses (the actual Bayridge stock): NO strata, NO Form B, NO strata fees — diligence is title, municipal rules (Zoning Bylaw No. 4662) and any registered covenants only, stated plainly. Secondary suites must be registered with the District.

District zoning and plan: Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010 governs — Section 200's RS single-family zones state minimum site areas of 8,094 m² in RS1, 1,625 m² in RS2, 975 m² in RS3 and RS10, 731 m² in RS4 and 488 m² in RS5, and list secondary suites and a detached secondary suite among permitted uses; the ground-oriented dwelling rules cap a lot at 4 dwellings (6 within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop). The Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 4985, 2018; Council adopted OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 5406, 2025, bringing the OCP into alignment with the Interim Housing Needs Report. (The Bylaw 2506 / 2220 pair sometimes seen in area files belongs to White Rock ONLY — it has no application in West Vancouver.)

Hazard permits — the live Bayridge checks: the District requires a Foreshore Development Permit for work within the Foreshore Development Permit Area (waterfront property or other properties at risk of coastal flooding), an Environmental Development Permit for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank, and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area (within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface) — the foreshore area is the live check on Marine Drive waterfront lots here, and new habitable space must meet the Flood Construction Level where that risk applies.

blocks.text: Good to know about Bayridge

items.t: Zero is a carried, re-verified result here, not a first-pass gap. Four passes, one answer.

The District is smaller than the name suggests. West Vancouver's 2021 Census population was 44,122 (Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Profile) — the whole District, of which this waterfront slope is one residential pocket with no commercial centre of its own confirmed on a District source.

The slope's one school carries a programme, not just a catchment. West Bay Elementary offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme — the programme is a school programme, and West Bay remains the catchment elementary for the sample address; do not present a programme school elsewhere as this area's catchment school.

The District lists Westmount Active Transportation, Pedestrian, and Road Safety Improvements as a major project — the address road for Benbow Park (Westmount Place) sits inside a named works program, a diligence item for lots on that corridor.

Half the tax bill is not the District's. Approximately 50% of a West Vancouver tax bill is collected by the District and remitted to other taxing authorities — the District's own share of a Bayridge tax notice is only about half the total a buyer sees.

Care and hospital anchors are east and across the inlet. The West Vancouver Community Health Centre (2121 Marine Drive) provides primary health care to residents of West Vancouver, Lions Bay and Bowen Island per Vancouver Coastal Health, and Lions Gate Hospital (231 East 15th Street, North Vancouver) is the North Shore hospital — neither sits in Bayridge.

items.t: Established slope and waterfront lots: single-family dwellings in the RS zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010, Section 200, on the slope above Marine Drive and on the waterfront streets — predominantly freehold detached in the sources read; any specific strata product in the area is UNVERIFIED.

Lot character from the zone ladder, as stated: RS minimum site areas run from 488 m² (RS5) to 8,094 m² (RS1), with RS2 at 1,625 m², RS3 and RS10 at 975 m² and RS4 at 731 m². These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size; the zone on a specific lot is shown on the District's Zoning Map (Bylaw Section 852). Secondary suites and a detached secondary suite are permitted uses in the single-family zones, and secondary suites must be registered with the District.

Serviced position, as the District states it: West Vancouver water and sewer utilities are metered and billed quarterly by the District — the serviced position for District lots as the District states it. ALR vs non-ALR: parcel-level ALR status: UNVERIFIED in the research. No ALR percentage split is stated; check any parcel on ALC mapping.

Flood/foreshore position: the Foreshore Development Permit Area covers waterfront property or other properties at risk of coastal flooding — the live check on Marine Drive waterfront lots here — and new habitable space must meet the Flood Construction Level where that risk applies.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Bayridge

items.t: Zoning — Zoning Bylaw No. 4662, 2010: the RS single-family zones state the minimum site areas in and list secondary suites and a detached secondary suite among permitted uses; secondary suites must be registered with the District. The bylaw's ground-oriented dwelling rules state 4 dwellings maximum per lot, and 6 maximum if the site is wholly or partly within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop.

OCP — Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 4985, 2018: the District plan covering the area; Council adopted OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 5406, 2025, bringing the OCP into alignment with the Interim Housing Needs Report. A local area plan naming Bayridge is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).

SSMUH / added units as the District states it: RS-zone lots carry the suite positions above (secondary suite + detached secondary suite, registration required) and the 4-dwelling / 6-near-bus-stop ground-oriented caps — eligibility and form are parcel-specific under Bylaw 4662; confirm with the District before pricing in suite potential.

Hazard Development Permits (District frame — the live Bayridge checks): a Foreshore Development Permit for work within the Foreshore Development Permit Area (waterfront property or other properties at risk of coastal flooding); an Environmental Development Permit for work within 15 metres of the top of any watercourse bank; and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit for work within the Wildfire Hazard Development Permit Area, described as within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface. The foreshore area is the live check on Marine Drive waterfront lots.

Strata block (for completeness — no Bayridge strata stock is verified): Form B diligence (provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Bayridge ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

West Vancouver property taxes + additional school tax: District 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; approximately 50% of the bill is collected for other taxing authorities. At Bayridge price points the additional school tax can apply — 0.2% on the residential portion between $3 million and $4 million and 0.4% above $4 million for 2026, rising to 0.3% and 0.6% on January 1, 2027.

faq.q: Is Bayridge an official West Vancouver neighbourhood?
faq.a: No official District neighbourhood or planning-area name "Bayridge" was confirmed in District sources — it is a local area/site name for the West Bay–Westmount slope in the District of West Vancouver, covered District-wide by the Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4985, 2018.

faq.q: Which public elementary school is in the area?
faq.a: West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, Kindergarten to Grade 7, offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme. For that sample address the SD45 locator gives West Bay Elementary and Rockridge Secondary (8–12); SD45 has no middle tier and catchments are address-based.

faq.q: What bus serves Marine Drive by Bayridge?
faq.a: Route 250 runs between Vancouver and Dundarave and Horseshoe Bay via Marine Drive, through Park Royal and over the Lions Gate Bridge.

faq.q: What hazard permits can apply on a waterfront or creek-side lot?
faq.a: A Foreshore Development Permit in the Foreshore Development Permit Area, an Environmental Development Permit for work within 15 metres of the top of a watercourse bank, and a Wildfire Hazard Development Permit within 100 metres of an undisturbed forest interface.

faq.q: When were West Vancouver property taxes due in 2026?
faq.a: July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on unpaid current taxes on July 2, 2026 and a further 5% on outstanding current taxes on September 2, 2026; about half the bill is collected for other taxing authorities.

faq.q: Are there any condos in Bayridge at all?
faq.a: None verified. A buyer set on a strata apartment should look at Ambleside or Dundarave, east of this area, not at Bayridge itself.

faq.q: What are the market stats for Bayridge condos?
faq.a: UNCONFIRMED — none exist in Jared's reports. West Vancouver is outside SnapStats coverage in the FVR + GVR September 2026 reports, so there is no sub-area inventory, sold count, sales ratio or median for this area, and no other source is substituted here.

faq.q: Can a house here hold suites or multiple units?
faq.a: The RS single-family zones list secondary suites and a detached secondary suite among permitted uses, suites must be registered with the District, and the ground-oriented dwelling rules cap a lot at 4 dwellings (6 if wholly or partly within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop). That is a freehold-house question, not a condo question — the zone on a specific lot is shown on the District's Zoning Map.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Bayridge address?
faq.a: School District 45 catchments are address-based. For the sample address 3175 Thompson Place (West Bay Elementary), the SD45 School Locator result recorded in the master research is West Bay Elementary (Primary K–3 and Elementary 4–7) and Rockridge Secondary (8–12). West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place, is Kindergarten to Grade 7 and offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme; SD45 has no middle-school tier. Other addresses must be checked in the locator.

faq.q: Where are West Vancouver townhouses, actually?
faq.a: Ambleside, Altamont, Chartwell outside Whitby, Chelsea Park and Bayridge verify zero.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Bayridge address?
faq.a: Address-based in SD45 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle tier). West Bay Elementary, 3175 Thompson Place (IB Primary Years Programme), is in the area; for that sample address the SD45 locator gives West Bay Elementary and Rockridge Secondary. That is one address's result — verify each address in the locator.

faq.q: Can I put a suite in a Bayridge house for family or a caregiver?
faq.a: The RS zones permit a secondary suite and a detached secondary suite, and suites must be registered with the District. A house with suites stays a fee-simple house — NO strata, NO Form B, NO strata fees — unless a strata plan is registered for the lot, which is UNCONFIRMED for any Bayridge lot in the sources checked.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant lot in Bayridge?
faq.a: No presale lot offering was verified.
